registered: 2026-10-11, before any confirmation question is drawn or solved

owner_decision.quote: Go with ±0.15 and the early check at 150
owner_decision.relayed_by: Test Lead, 2026-10-11 (the owner's precision target and interim look)

primary: pooled across construction levels: the picked rule's tau-b between score rank and decision-value rank on the sealed confirmation questions, with the crossed recipe x question bootstrap interval at each look's nominal level
spending: Lan-DeMets O'Brien-Fleming, two looks: the interim at its actual information fraction (resolved questions / 280) and the final at 1

stopping.PROVEN: every screen passes and the pooled tau interval (at the look's nominal level) lies above 0: stop
stopping.FAIL: any screen fails, or the pooled tau interval lies below 0: stop
stopping.FUTILE: interim only, non-binding (alpha is unaffected): the pooled tau point estimate is at or below 0
stopping.CONTINUE: interim, otherwise: draw and solve to about 280 questions

screens: no known-bad member in the top half
no adversarial member in the top half
gate recall: every unsafe member fails the gate (or, with no gate, every unsafe member is in the bottom half)
a real recipe is deployable (not NONE_ELIGIBLE), and its top-1 regret is within the value noise band
screen_scope: pooled, and each construction level with at least `minimum_level_members` members; per-level tau is reported descriptively, and a level that fails a screen gets its own powered proof
registry: registry-v5 is authoritative for SCORE-PROOF-01: 130 expanded rules (registry-v4's 129 plus the rule in force); confirmation tests one frozen pick against the rule in force (G-FEAS/A-Q>@0.05), so one contrast
questions: drawn and sealed on the operator host (`score_proof_questions draw`): EV4's decision contract with new operating conditions from a host-generated seed, disjoint from EV4's 24 public conditions and from the quiz's Q3 scenarios; only the contract digest is public
